description: Brachina Gorge Heysen Range Lower. 63km North North East of Adelaide
comments: Grazing impact high- goat tracks and droppings. Rabbit droppings also. Lots of Yellow footed rock wallabies close to the site.  Long unburnt- not much grass to carry fire. Overnight rain. Cheilanthes sieberi subsp. sieberi opening up. Slope uneven, 17- 18 degree slope to the south west.  South west corner almost in creek. Another creek running along southern edge of quadrat. Bottom transect on southern boundary goes through this gully. Weed impact low- some Carrichtera annua. Rocky on the surface, moss where there would be bare ground. Some outcrop at the top of the site. Steep slope on the mid reaches of the Brachina gorge catchment. Very rocky, soil sampling stopped by rock at most sub sites.
location_description: Brachina lower.Largely unchanged since previous visit possibly more Carrichtera annua. Grazing impact goat, rabbits and kangaroos very similar to last visit. Site long unburnt. Introduced plant species, Carrichtera annua, possibly some other annuals. Surface strew predominately cobble, gravel and boulders. Some outcrop, which is covered in lichen as are a lot of the rocks. Substrate is sandstone for the outcrop and surface strew, not heavily metamorphosed. Slope is still a complex slope. Gully in SE corner, the predominant slope direction is to the SW at about 18o.

description: Scotia Private Nature Reserve. 10.4km south west of ranger station. 138km west north west of Pooncarie
comments: Plain within sand plain with a gentle slope to the north east. Long unburnt- no evidence of fire in site or surrounding Mallee. Introduced plant species effect is high- Salvia herb is dominant through ground layer but much more native species than similar site on Tarawi (NSAMDD0010). Grazing effect is low at present- scratching at the bottom of shrubs from kangaroos. Would have been heavily impacted in the past- close to an old dam. Possibly cleared. Lots of calcareous gravel through the site.
location_description: Scotia Sanctuary. 10.4km south west of ranger station. 138km west north west of Pooncarie

description: Dutton River Station 11km North of homestead. 87km North east of Richmond
comments: Rapidly eroding toe slope of hills. Close to the basalt escarpment. Slope is broadly to the south away from the ranges. In south west corner is severely eroding gully creeping in on southern boundary and along western edge. Dry- only a few green tussock grasses in gully. Grazing effect is high, pads and scats. Long unburnt 10+ years. Introduced plants- only one small clump of Cenchrus ciliaris. Strew Lithology mixed. Larger cobbles basalt.
location_description: Dutton River Station,  11km North of homestead. 87km North east of Richmond

description: 5km West south west of Ross. 79.9km south east of Launceston
comments: The vegetation community is confined to the plot, about 75 m from the centre. The north-east corner is a few metres in from an access track while the southern edge is about 10-15 m in from a rarely-used track that runs up the ridge. The site is situated on a spur or hill crest as the site is almost on the ridge capping. The slope through the middle is about 6-7 degrees with a north easterly aspect. On the northern edge the slope is a little bit steeper at ~8 degrees and tends towards the south east. The site has been disturbed in the past with some timber cutting, unknown as to whether it has been clear felled or not, but there has definitely been some logs cut possibly for firewood. Regenerating. About 30 m north is a mudstone quarry. The site has been set back from the quarry while still capturing the underlying mudstone lithology. Surface strew is sparse with some gravels and cobbles, however, the lithology is predominantly mudstone with some finer grained sandstones. Very long unburnt. One big dead old stump potentially burnt but no recent scarring. Site situated in a conservation covenant – just over the fence the land is more formally grazed. Grazing pressure is high from kangaroos and deer
visit_notes: Transect East to West 5, point 88 substrate is 'lichen on rock'.
location_description: 5km West south west of Ross. 79.9km south east of Launceston

description: Murray Sunset National Park, about 26kms north west of Underbool.
comments: Plot is on a plain. Lots of Cryptogam crust. Grazing effect is low at present- bulldozer has been through the site ripping 1 or 2 rabbit warrens. Very long unburnt- at least 10 to 15 years. Introduced plant effect is low- but difficult to tell as forbs are only beginning to shoot. Some Sisymbrium but cover low. No Carrichtera annua noted. Slope- site has a 1 degree slope to the north west but more or less flat though sloping slightly at the corners of the site.
location_description: Murray Sunset NP, about 26kms northwest of Underbool. Belah open woodland
